title: Utility Line Protection Plans Timelines, Cancellation Fee and Transfer Schedule
content:
# Timelines, Cancellation Fee and Transfer Schedule

The periods below are counted in calendar days and apply to the Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans as shown; this schedule fixes the length of each period on each plan.

| Plan | Waiting period | Free-look period | Refund issued within | Payment grace period | Suspension cure period | Renewal notice lead time | Late-renewal grace period | Cancellation administrative fee | Transferable to a new owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Exterior Water Service Line Plan | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | $0.00 | No |
| Bridgewell Exterior Electrical Line Plan | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | $0.00 | No |
| Bridgewell Exterior Sewer and Septic Line Plan | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | $0.00 | No |
| Bridgewell Interior Plumbing and Drainage Plan | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | $0.00 | No |
| Bridgewell Water and Sewer Line Bundle | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | $0.00 | No |
| Bridgewell Total Home Lines Plan | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | $0.00 | No |

## Definitions

- **Waiting period** — calendar days after enrollment before failures are covered.
- **Free-look period** — calendar days after enrollment within which a cancellation receives the free-look refund.
- **Refund issued within** — calendar days after cancellation within which a refund is issued.
- **Payment grace period** — calendar days after a premium's due date before nonpayment suspends coverage.
- **Suspension cure period** — calendar days after suspension during which paying the past-due balance reinstates the plan.
- **Renewal notice lead time** — the minimum calendar days before term end by which the renewal notice must be issued for automatic renewal.
- **Late-renewal grace period** — calendar days after term end during which an expired plan can be restored without a new waiting period.
- **Cancellation administrative fee** — the administrative fee on a cancellation, in US dollars.
- **Transferable to a new owner** — whether the plan can be transferred to a new owner of the property.

Every plan currently carries the same figures: 30 calendar days for each period, a $0.00 cancellation administrative fee, and no transfer to a new owner.
